factory.name: Hindsight Demo Metal Works
factory.description: A fictional composite metal fabrication plant created for Hindsight applicability demonstrations.
factory.source_note: Internal areas, assets, tasks, and controls are synthetic and must not be attributed to any real company.

areas.name: Stamping Area
areas.description: Mechanical press production and die handling.

areas.name: Loading Dock
areas.description: Trailer loading, unloading, and dock operations.

areas.name: Chemical Storage and Mixing
areas.description: Solvent transfer, paint mixing, and flammable-liquid storage.

tasks.name: metal stamping
tasks.description: Form sheet metal using a mechanical press and die.

tasks.name: die changing
tasks.description: Remove, install, and align press dies.

tasks.name: jam clearing
tasks.description: Remove stuck stock or parts from equipment.

tasks.name: press maintenance
tasks.description: Inspect, lubricate, troubleshoot, and repair presses.

tasks.name: arc welding
tasks.description: Join metal using manual or robotic arc welding.

tasks.name: weld cleaning
tasks.description: Clean spatter and finish welded parts.

tasks.name: gas cylinder changing
tasks.description: Connect and replace compressed shielding-gas cylinders.

tasks.name: robotic cell maintenance
tasks.description: Enter and service a robotic welding enclosure.

tasks.name: forklift driving
tasks.description: Move material using powered industrial trucks.

tasks.name: pallet stacking
tasks.description: Place and retrieve palletized loads.

tasks.name: forklift battery charging
tasks.description: Charge and inspect electric forklift batteries.

tasks.name: truck loading and unloading
tasks.description: Transfer loads between trailers and the facility.

tasks.name: dock leveler operation
tasks.description: Position and operate a dock leveler.

tasks.name: trailer entry
tasks.description: Enter a secured trailer with personnel or equipment.

tasks.name: lathe turning
tasks.description: Machine rotating metal stock on a lathe.

tasks.name: abrasive grinding
tasks.description: Remove material using a fixed abrasive wheel.

tasks.name: drill press operation
tasks.description: Drill holes in clamped workpieces.

tasks.name: general maintenance
tasks.description: Repair and service plant equipment.

tasks.name: solvent transfer
tasks.description: Transfer solvent between approved containers and process vessels.

tasks.name: paint mixing
tasks.description: Measure and mix coatings and solvents.

tasks.name: chemical spill cleanup
tasks.description: Contain and clean a small chemical spill.

tasks.name: chemical inventory
tasks.description: Receive, inspect, and count chemical containers.

hazards.name: crush
hazards.description: A person can be compressed between moving or fixed objects.

hazards.name: caught-in
hazards.description: Body parts or clothing can be drawn into machinery.

hazards.name: amputation
hazards.description: Cutting or crushing motion can sever a body part.

hazards.name: unexpected startup
hazards.description: Equipment may move or energize during intervention.

hazards.name: electrical shock
hazards.description: Contact with energized components can cause shock or arc injury.

hazards.name: thermal burn
hazards.description: Hot metal, sparks, or surfaces can burn workers.

hazards.name: welding fume exposure
hazards.description: Airborne welding fume can be inhaled.

hazards.name: fire or explosion
hazards.description: Ignition of flammable material can cause fire or explosion.

hazards.name: arc radiation
hazards.description: Welding arcs emit ultraviolet and infrared radiation.

hazards.name: struck-by
hazards.description: A moving vehicle, load, or object can strike a person.

hazards.name: vehicle collision
hazards.description: Powered equipment can collide with people or structures.

hazards.name: vehicle tip-over
hazards.description: A forklift can overturn due to speed, grade, or unstable load.

hazards.name: falling object
hazards.description: Stored or lifted material can fall.

hazards.name: fall from dock edge
hazards.description: A person or vehicle can fall from an open dock edge.

hazards.name: unexpected trailer movement
hazards.description: A trailer can move or separate while being loaded.

hazards.name: rotating-part entanglement
hazards.description: Hair, gloves, clothing, or body parts can wrap around rotation.

hazards.name: laceration
hazards.description: Sharp stock, tools, or fragments can cut workers.

hazards.name: chemical exposure
hazards.description: Skin, eye, or respiratory contact with chemicals can cause injury.

hazards.name: flammable vapor
hazards.description: Flammable vapor may accumulate and ignite.

hazards.name: spill and slip
hazards.description: Released liquid can create a slipping hazard.

hazards.name: compressed gas release
hazards.description: Damaged or mishandled cylinders can release stored pressure.

worker_roles.name: chemical handler

worker_roles.name: production supervisor
worker_roles.description: Owns production-area assets and approves operational risk controls.

energy_sources.name: mechanical stored energy

energy_sources.name: thermal energy

energy_sources.name: vehicle kinetic energy
energy_sources.description: Motion and momentum of powered vehicles and loads.

safety_controls.description: Physical guard prevents access to hazardous motion.

safety_controls.name: lockout tagout
safety_controls.description: Authorized isolation and verification of hazardous energy.

safety_controls.name: local exhaust ventilation
safety_controls.description: Captures welding fume or vapor near its source.

safety_controls.name: welding screen
safety_controls.description: Screens shield nearby workers from arc radiation and sparks.

safety_controls.name: robot cell interlock
safety_controls.description: Interlocked gate stops automatic robot motion.

safety_controls.name: forklift operator restraint
safety_controls.description: Seat belt or restraint keeps operator inside the protective zone.

safety_controls.name: pedestrian separation
safety_controls.description: Barriers and marked routes separate vehicles and pedestrians.

safety_controls.name: adjustable tool rest
safety_controls.description: Maintains safe work support at an abrasive wheel.

safety_controls.name: lathe chuck guard
safety_controls.description: Reduces access to rotating chuck hazards.

safety_controls.name: flammable-liquid cabinet
safety_controls.description: Approved cabinet limits fire exposure of stored liquids.

safety_controls.name: bonding and grounding
safety_controls.description: Controls static ignition during flammable-liquid transfer.
